text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We were able to safely finish our 
preparations for the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the race, ready to take on 
the challenge with confidence. Around 
noon, we arrived at a hotel not far from 
Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, a hotel all the way up a 
mountain like this...!
choice_data_list:
Apparently the view from the window is 
amazing!

Apparently the view from the window is 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Really? Hehe, I wonder if we can see all 
the way to the racetrack.
choice_data_list: 窓から見える景色、最高らしいぞ
窓から見える景色、最高らしいよ
choice_data_list_en: I hear the view from the window is incredible.
I hear the view from the window is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to do whatever I could to lift 
her spirits before she takes on this major 
race— or so I thought, but..."
choice_data_list: （よかった、喜んでくれて）
choice_data_list_en: (I'm glad she's pleased.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The scenery from the window changes color 
completely between night and morning... 
It's so gorgeous, I was deeply moved!
choice_data_list: Ready to give it your all in the race now?

Think you can give it your best in the 
race now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's my first GⅠ race, so I'm 
going to give it everything I've got!
choice_data_list: これでレースも頑張れそうか？
これでレースも頑張れそう？
choice_data_list_en: Feel ready to give it your all in the race now?
Feel ready to give it your all in the race now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Whoops, the elevator's here! Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Kya!? ...D-Did it stop...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wah!! Even the electricity...!
choice_data_list: Let's contact the hotel staff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Upon asking, it turned out they still 
didn't know the cause of the elevator 
malfunction. We would have to wait a 
little while for it to be resolved.
choice_data_list: ホテルの人に連絡しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's contact the hotel staff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the end, after being trapped in the 
elevator for over an hour, we were finally 
freed. Unfortunately, however...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You can't get the car out...?
choice_data_list: Looks like they're all out...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What should I do...? Will I make it in 
time for the meetup...?
choice_data_list: 全部出払っちゃったらしい……
choice_data_list_en: Looks like they're all out...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Should I run? If I sprint full speed 
down the mountain...!"
choice_data_list:
I can't let you do something that 
dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but... if there's no other 
way, I can still run. So—"
choice_data_list: そんな危険なことはさせられないよ
choice_data_list_en: I can't let you do something that dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: ブエナ、大丈夫だ。任せてくれ！
ブエナ、大丈夫だよ。任せて！
choice_data_list_en: Buena, it's all right. Leave it to me!
Buena, it's okay. Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are two things I must consider: 
getting Buena Vista there on time for the 
meeting, and—making sure she gets a chance 
to refresh herself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. ...*pant*...
choice_data_list: (She's getting anxious after all...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pursing her lips slightly, she breathes 
shallowly. It's a truly minor gesture, 
but—
choice_data_list: （やっぱり……不安になってる）
choice_data_list_en: (She really is... feeling anxious.)

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little longer... until the race 
starts..."

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: "Phew... Huff..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a gesture I'd seen her make 
countless times since childhood—an 
unconscious habit whenever she felt 
vulnerable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being trapped in a dark elevator must have 
completely exhausted her. At this rate, 
she won't be able to show her true 
strength...
choice_data_list:
(A way to clear both at the same time 
would be—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just had an idea. It's all or nothing, 
but with a bit of luck—
choice_data_list: （ふたつを同時にクリアする方法は――）
choice_data_list_en: (A way to achieve both at the same time isâ)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! Made it in time!
choice_data_list: ブエナ、ケーブルカーだ！
choice_data_list_en: Buena, look, a cable car!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a cable car near the hotel, and 
we managed to hop on right as it was 
departing. What's more—
choice_data_list: 運がよかったな……！
運がよかったね……！
choice_data_list_en: We got lucky...!
We got lucky...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The taxi called by the hotel was waiting 
at the station at the foot of the 
mountain... allowing us to arrive just 
before the meeting time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a great idea! Taking the 
cable car, I mean.
choice_data_list:
I was looking into it because I thought it 
might make you happy.

I was looking it up, thinking it might 
make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: 君が喜ぶかもと思って、調べてたから
貴方が喜ぶかもと思って、調べてたから
choice_data_list_en: I was looking into it thinking it might make you happy.
I looked into it because I thought you might be happy

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"—I managed to catch it just in time, 
but... Will I really make it?"
choice_data_list: 下っていく景色、綺麗だったろ？
下っていく景色、綺麗だったでしょう？
choice_data_list_en: The scenery as we went down was beautiful, right?
The scenery as we went down was beautiful, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? ...Whoa...! There's still snow 
left... It's so magical and beautiful—"
choice_data_list: 『……な、ブエナ。顔を上げてごらん』
『……ね、ブエナ。顔を上げてごらん』
choice_data_list_en: '...Come on, Buena. Lift your head.'
'...Hey, Buena. Lift your head.'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Because you were prepared for 
this...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because you prepared so much for me, I'm 
able to run in this race, aren't I?
choice_data_list: I just got lucky, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And you were the one who drew that to us!
choice_data_list: たまたま運がよかっただけだよ
choice_data_list_en: It was just pure luck, really.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...From here on out, it's my turn to seize 
victory—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—Don't worry, leave it to me. You worked 
so hard for me, and I'm going to answer 
that.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Keep believing in me, just like you always 
have. If you do... I can become stronger 
than ever before!
